description: This file defines the NotesListScreen widget, which serves as the main notes listing interface in a Flutter app. It includes search functionality, category filtering, and navigation to note editing or creation screens.

classes.name: NotesListScreen
classes.description: Main screen class that displays the list of notes with search and category filtering options.

classes.name: _NotesListScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the internal logic, search, category filtering, and UI for NotesListScreen.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the notes list, including app bar, body with note list or empty state, and FAB.

methods.name: _buildEmptyState
methods.description: Builds a UI widget indicating no notes are present.

methods.name: _showSearchDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog to input search query and update the filter.

methods.name: _buildCategoryChips
methods.description: Creates a horizontal list of filter chips for selecting note categories.
